requirements.quote: `fingerprint(signal)` is stable across copies (strips ids, timestamps and numbers).

`cluster(signals, openIssues)` dedups against open issues (the fingerprint is embedded in the issue body as `<!-- FORGE:SIGNAL_REF … -->`) and against other signals; 15 copies of one pg memo become one cluster.

`classify(cluster, rules)` returns one of incident|defect|monitoring-bug|expected-class|deploy-fallout|transient. Rules are deterministic and read from the repo's NORTHSTAR alert rules via bin/lean/decision-engine.mjs `loadPolicy`.
`validate(cluster, io)` runs the repo's declared read-only queries and attaches reproduced evidence; a cluster without evidence is not fileable. expected-class is counted, never filed.
De-duplication and fingerprinting, with fixtures from the AlterLab 2026-10-29 memo set (70 memos give the expected clusters).
Classification and validation, with expected-class and monitoring-bug handling.
Fixtures: `bin/lean/fixtures/prodwatch/` holds an ANONYMISED 70-memo set that keeps the 2026-10-29 cluster structure (8 issues, 18 duplicate or transient, and the rest).
Capture it read-only via the host's prod_monitor capability, then scrub hostnames, customer ids and secrets.
requirements.why: Needs the host prod_monitor capability and production access; the lane ships a synthetic anonymised set with the same structure, a real capture can replace it later.
requirements.bucket: owner:capture and scrub the real 2026-10-29 memo set via prod_monitor, replace the synthetic fixture

requirements.quote: Rules: pure functions with an injected `io` (exec/gh/llm/now) like bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs; read-only by contract; deterministic first; core stays repo-agnostic (#1347). Repo is PUBLIC: no raw customer data in fixtures.
